caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of material with a cross-stitch pattern composed of X-shaped stitches in various colors. The background of the piece is light brown. The cross-stitch design includes sections of red, green, blue, yellow, pink, brown, and orange, arranged in an abstract, non-symmetrical composition. There are large patches of red and pink grouped together, surrounded by borders of blue, yellow, and brown. Green and a small amount of pink thread appear in the upper left corner. Blue and yellow colors cluster toward the center and right sides of the composition. The overall layout is made up of blocky, almost pixel-like clusters of colors. The piece is centered on a white or off-white canvas, with a thin margin visible around the stitched rectangle. There is handwritten text in the bottom left corner reading "A 2255" and a signature in the bottom right corner that says "Ruth M. Basner."
title: Table Cover
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
